text:
Will P.: uploaded the first pass of the co-branded solution brief to GDrive: https://drive.reed/redwood/partner-assets/1981234567
Maria C.: cool — I see both SVG and PNGs in the artboard folder. can we confirm the logo lockup spacing? our brand guide has 16px min clearspace but partner's guide calls for 24px.
Devon (Design): visually 16px looks tight with their logotype. proposal: use our 16px baseline but add a subtle divider line when their logo is adjacent. mock attached: `s3://rdw-assets/mockups/1981234567-lockup.png`
Sara (PM): need to check marketplace thumbnail constraints too — Azure marketplace requires a 1:1 300x300 for listing, while GCP marketplace wants 4:3 1200x900. does that change how we position the logos?
Will P.: good catch. Devon can we export two crops? one centered square, one horizontal 4:3 with padding. use the safe-zone we agreed on.
Devon (Design): done. pushed `co-branded-exports_v1.zip`. note: partner asked to keep their tag line intact — that pushes the lockup right. i trimmed our tagline to headline-only so they fit.
Maria C.: legal flagged a trademark usage line in partner's guidelines — they require "TM" on second mention. sam-legal can you confirm if we need to add TM to every inline use in the brief?
sam-legal: quick from legal — single TM on first inline usage is fine for marketing collateral; but partner provided a signed asset license? if not, ask them to send brand use approval. also avoid implying endorsement: swap "Redwood + Acme" to "Redwood integration with Acme" in the one-pager.
Will P.: edited language in the doc per legal. changed headline to: "Redwood integration with Acme — low-latency inference at scale"
Sara (PM): also flag: case study quote from their VP mentions PCI compliance — is that allowed? we shouldn't overstate. sam-legal?
sam-legal: remove the word "certified" unless they can provide cert docs. replace with "configured to support PCI-relevant workloads".
Devon (Design): updated quote layout to fit new wording. also added a small callout with "Partner logo courtesy of Acme, used with permission" as footer.
Maria C.: partner marketing asked for a single-sheet solution brief + 1-pager customer story + marketplace tile. timeline: want assets by EOW. are we ok?
Will P.: realistic: Design can finalize exports by Thu, legal sign-off Fri morning, publishing team submits marketplace packages Fri afternoon. @sam-legal please confirm ETA for final review.
sam-legal: can review Fri 9am PT. if partner sends usage approval PDF by Thu EOD we're on track.
brand-bot: Reminder: Redwood brand guide v2 requires alternate white logo on dark backgrounds. use `logo_alt_white.svg` for dark thumbnails.
Will P.: thanks all. next steps: Devon — finalize exports and upload zips to the drive. Maria — request formal brand usage approval from partner and relay to legal. Sara — prepare marketplace checklist and share prefilled submission.
Sara (PM): shared checklist in thread: https://confluence/repo/marketplace-checklists/co-brand-brief
Will P.: i'll ping partner after this thread and tag expected deliverables. :thumbsup:
